Zábradlie je nainštalované na schody do obytného domu, čas ukáže koľko vydrží. Fast delivery, well packaged. The assembly is not difficult. The concrete anchors are not the best quality, the screw heads are very low, which makes it difficult to screw in. I bought this stroller for my 11 lb cat who loves to be outside but couldn't wear a leash for a few weeks after a surgery. What a great little stroller! Easy to set up, collapse and use. Plenty of space and viewing areas There are only a few quirks I don't like: -clips on the leash inside are just too small for my harness but easy enough to replace -The side of the stroller where all the different fabrics come together doesn't totally seal and I wonder about escape attempts -it is only really meant for super smooth tarmac, bumps on sidewalk and older road surfaces
